insight: YC S23 startup that has raised $65M total — a $40M Series B led by Emergence Capital landed in January 2025.
name: Bland AI
tagline: Build, run, and monitor AI phone agents that hold real conversations at scale.
description: Enterprise voice-AI platform for automating high-volume inbound and outbound phone calls. Bland runs the full stack — language model, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and telephony — on its own infrastructure, with conversational pathways, voice cloning, and webhook integrations. Positioned for regulated industries with SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI compliance.

modelSupport.notes: Managed stack: LLM, STT, TTS, and telephony bundled per minute.

edge: Runs the whole voice stack (LLM+STT+TTS+telephony) on its own infrastructure at one per-minute price, with enterprise compliance like HIPAA and SOC 2.
pros: Full voice stack on one platform
cons: No free tier — billed per minute
Per-minute costs add up at scale

references.title: Bland AI scores $16M to automate enterprise phone calls with agents
